evidence_notes: WSP is the method of all four studies (p.3-4): Claude Opus 5.5 writes small MLPs (one linear or one width-6 ReLU layer) as JSON and edits them from forward-pass diagnostics, so direct_values and closed_loop. Weights were frozen on practice instances before test (p.4-5) but with no timestamped registry or hashes, so prereg none. The MARTA gain is fully matched by SCIP's pseudocost rule (p.10, p.14) and the synthetic rule fails on MIPLIB (p.9); Claude wrote all code, weights, analysis and text (p.1, p.17); code at github.com/butkeraites/llm-written-weights-or (p.14). Exact parameter counts are not given.
